title: My Family
text:
My name is Ali. I live with my family in a small house. My mother is a teacher. My father is a driver. I have one sister, and her name is Ayşe.

We have dinner together every evening. My sister and I help my mother in the kitchen. On Sunday, we visit our grandmother. She makes very good soup. We love her very much.

questions.text: What does the narrator's mother do?
When does the family visit the grandmother?
How does the narrator probably feel about the grandmother?
options: The narrator loves her very much.
The narrator is afraid of her.
The narrator does not know her.
The narrator is angry with her.

questions.text: What kind of family does the narrator have?
options: A large family with many cousins
A family that lives far away from others
A family that never eats together

vocabulary.definition: a group of people who are related to each other
the mother of your mother or father
the room where food is cooked
the main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Küçük bir evde ailemle birlikte yaşıyorum. Annem bir öğretmen. Babam bir şoför. Bir kız kardeşim var ve onun adı Ayşe.
Her akşam birlikte akşam yemeği yeriz. Kız kardeşim ve ben annemize mutfakta yardım ederiz. Pazar günü büyükannemizi ziyaret ederiz. O çok güzel çorba yapar. Onu çok seviyoruz.
